top_signal.title: Ex- Management Consultant | Recently left Job, Can efficiently work for you
top_signal.summary: Hello everyone,   I recently stepped away from management consulting and am opening up my time to work directly with founders, startups, and businesses that need help solving problems, improving operations, building products, or scaling profitably. I have done BTech and an MBA from a recognisable, top institutes .   Over the past 7+ years, I have worked across consulting, corporate operations, business analytics, and startup product development. Much of my consulting experience has been with Middle Eastern and Asian organisations across IT, e-commerce, retail, FMCG, energy, electronics, manufacturing, and fintech. Some of the key roles that I anchored were founder office, Chief of staff, management consulting, Business Intelligence, Sales Growth, Supply Chain Ops Manager   My work has largely involved taking ambiguous business problems, breaking them down to their root causes, and translating the findings into practical solutions. This could mean identifying profitability gaps, redesigning a supply chain, building a business case, improving a sales funnel, or taking a product from an idea to execution.   Alongside consulting, I have also worked in a founder's role, building SaaS products and applications from scratch. Managed entire team of Developers, System Design and Backend Engineers, QA, Design.
